chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Earlier acting: school plays and a love scene in Black Narcissus
summary: He did school plays as a boy and, at Pathe, played a love scene taking Buck's girlfriend Beulah in Black Narcissus; he did not care to seek more such roles.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: But you had not had a lot of acting experience as well, this was the first --

Oh, yeah, I did that in school. I did that in school, last day of school, I put on their school plays -- the cowboy and Indian things, you know. We was shootin' and fall -- did a lot of plays in school days. But I never did no part like this. Like doing a live scene -- emh-emh.
How did you feel about doing those things?

studio, I did a love scene in that show. That was before I got to "Porgy and Bess." Understand, I did this film called "Black Narcissus," there was a girl called Beulah. She was Buck's girlfriend and I was supposed to take her away from Buck in this play, then being a singer it was easy for me to renew the love scene.
How did you feel about doing those types of scenes? Were you comfortable with them?
When you finished the show, were you desirous to do additional shows like this type of thing?
Or were you anxious to get back into the grove of Buck and Bubbles?
No, I wasn't anxious to do nothing but carry on as far as I could.
